task.title: 检查已配置设置
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查已配置设置. Use Configured mode to understand what the profile currently applies by domain, category, and source.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查已配置设置. Open a saved profile in All Settings.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查已配置设置. Configured mode focuses on values already present in the profile, not on every possible policy. Domain summaries help you explain the active configuration.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查已配置设置. Switch to Configured mode.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查已配置设置. Review the configured summary cards by domain or category.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查已配置设置. Open a category to inspect the settings applied there.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：检查已配置设置. Use source filters if you need to separate baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw values.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查架构、值来源以及更改后果。

result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 You can describe the active policy and managed preference values applied by the profile.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if a value is missing, switch to Catalog mode or clear source filters before deciding it is absent.
